summary: Kinder Morgan, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an amended and restated revolving credit facility. The company, as borrower, amended its existing $3.5 billion facility to extend the maturity from August 20, 2026 to May 21, 2031 and increase swingline loan availability from $50 million to $400 million. Barclays Bank PLC acts as administrative agent. This is a routine refinancing of a credit facility, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing contains no special-situation terms; it is purely a financing arrangement. No watch items or risk-arb angle apply.
